mechanism1_ReactSuspenseStreaming.description: app/loading.tsx triggers Next.js Suspense streaming SSR for async Server Components (LocationPage awaiting params).
mechanism1_ReactSuspenseStreaming.initialHtml: Next.js outputs <head>, <header>, and <main class="flex-1"><template id="B:0"></template><div Loading.../></main> followed by <footer>.

mechanism1_ReactSuspenseStreaming.crawlerImpact: In default 'Text Only' mode (JavaScript disabled), Screaming Frog's HTML content parser strips or ignores elements marked with the HTML5 `hidden` attribute or only extracts the initial `<main>` element. The visible content hash computed by Screaming Frog is therefore derived solely from the loading placeholder ('ALINA VIP Loading...'), resulting in identical content hashes across all 23 URLs.
